candidate.slot_conventions: for each required slot, up to 2 questions from OTHER templates of the tuning pool with the same named slot_id or the same description, with the slot's reference value; never the question's own template
candidate.unit_hints: v2: 'dimensionless' no longer described as a fraction scale (train gold: counts, multipliers, pip differences, squares of the question's own quantities)

win_iff.checkpoint: delta > 2*sigma_run (0.000962) and paired CI95 lower bound > 0
win_iff.lockbox: then one lockbox look (e_base vs e_conv, H-mode, aggregates only) must give checkpoint delta > 0 (PLAN.md §5.6)
win_iff.robustness: checkpoint delta >= 0 also on the exemplar-pool part (tuning-noex minus tuning-eval, never inspected case by case)
